conflict_topics: early-morning religious chanting vs. roommates' sleep/work schedules
scheduling of a trial time to test noise
dialogue_quality_notes: Participants gave concrete personal constraints (A: client presentation; B: exams; C: light sleeper) which grounded their positions.
Agent D offered a conditional mitigation (whisper) and a practical test—this moved discussion from abstract claims to a verifiable plan.
C’s proximity reopened a previously appearing agreement, appropriately preventing premature settlement.
evaluation.final_reason: The roommates reached a concrete, mutual agreement about when to run a noise trial: Agent D agreed to be quieter (‘I can be quieter’) and proposed a test morning; after negotiation the group agreed on a specific trial date — Agent D: 'Okay, so Friday morning it is.' This settles the immediate scheduling conflict (trial timing) but does not settle the broader incompatibility about daily 4:45 a.m. chanting for the next four weeks if the trial shows it remains audible.
position_change_notes: Agent D softened from 'I will chant every morning' to offering mitigation: 'I can be quieter' and to running a trial — explicit concessions to roommate concerns.

Agent A and Agent B maintained their constraints but conceded to a trial date (A: 'A trial is a good idea.'; A: 'Okay, Tuesday night works for me.' later switching to Friday), showing willingness to compromise on timing.
Agent C consistently retained concern and effectively reopened negotiations when previously unconsulted; C accepted a trial but requested Friday to avoid a work night.

round_scores.evidence: Agent A objects to 4:45 every morning because of a Monday 9 a.m. presentation (‘I can't be tired’). Agent D immediately offers to be quieter (‘I can be quieter’), softening the conflict but not resolving it.
Agent A requests specifics about 'quieter' given thin walls; Agent B adds their own constraint (exams on Tues/Thurs). More incompatible constraints appear, so conflict intensity increases.
Agent D specifies a 'very low whisper' but Agent A doubts even a whisper will be inaudible. Substantive disagreement about sufficiency of the mitigation remains.
Agent D proposes a one-morning trial; Agent A accepts the idea but excludes Sunday night because of their Monday presentation. The parties narrow options, reducing but not eliminating the conflict.
Agent B adds further constraints (cannot be Monday or Wednesday nights), creating a scheduling incompatibility among roommates and reopening intensity.
Agent A agrees to Tuesday night and Agent D accepts; scheduling progress is made though not final and C has not yet weighed in.
Agent B also agrees to Tuesday and Agent D says 'settled then.' Among A, B, D the trial appears settled, lowering conflict, but C remains unconsulted.
Agent C objects that it's not settled because their room is next to D's and they'd be more affected. This reopens the substantive issue.
Agent C notes being a very light sleeper and doubts even a whisper; Agent D reiterates the trial's purpose as a test. The incompatibility remains unresolved.
Agent D accepts that C is the 'main test' and says they'll find another plan if it wakes C; Agent C requests the trial be on Friday so it isn't a work night. No final date agreed yet.
Agent D says Friday is fine and asks A and B; Agent A accepts Friday. Scheduling moves toward agreement, lowering conflict.

Agent B agrees to Friday and Agent D confirms: 'Okay, so Friday morning it is.' The trial date is mutually agreed, but the underlying question—whether daily chanting will be acceptable after the trial—remains unresolved.

substantive_insights: Core tension is between a short-term religious vow requiring early-morning chanting and roommates’ competing, concrete morning obligations (presentation, exams, light sleeping).
The trial functions as an evidentiary device: it shifts the dispute from normative claims about rights to an empirical test of audibility.
Scheduling trade-offs (which nights are acceptable) were the main negotiable dimension; the deeper issue of whether chanting will be tolerated over four weeks remains contingent on the trial outcome.

normalizations: Removed resolution_round 12 because the final status is partially_resolved.
